title: Hungary as your next market for growth - Export

facts.fact: The page states Hungary is still growing at about 14%.
facts.quote: Still growing at about 14%, while maturing in terms of quality, Hungary is such an interesting market to enter right now.

facts.fact: The page lists a net monthly earnings increase of 10% as a main driver of Hungary's online growth.
The page reports 6,456,334 online shoppers in Hungary.
The page reports that online shoppers equal 68% of the Hungarian population.
The page reports 25,000 online shops in Hungary.
The page reports Hungary's e-commerce revenue at €5.7 billion for 2025.
The page reports 7.4% e-commerce growth for Hungary.
The page states that e-commerce in Hungary was worth 2.2 billion EUR in 2019.
facts.quote: E-commerce in Hungary was worth 2.2 billion EUR in 2019 (estimated YoY increase for 2020 was 30%)

facts.fact: The page gives an estimated year-over-year e-commerce increase of 30% for 2020 in Hungary.
The page states eMAG offers products in more than 1,500 categories.
The page states that 220volt offers 20,000 products.
facts.quote: 220volt offers 20 000 products from segments such as electronics, computers, smartphones, DIY, housing, and gardening.

facts.fact: The page states there are over 2000 Czech online stores on the Hungarian market.
facts.quote: There are over 2000 Czech online stores (and counting!) already on the market as a testament.

facts.fact: The page says Hungarian customers have high standards, including a 30-day return option.
facts.quote: they also have high standards, from the same day delivery to 30-day return option.
